title: 2-Hour ATV Ride on Rubicon Trail
blurb:
Upon arrival at the trailhead, meet 15 minutes before your start time trailhead, where you'll gear up for a 2-hour guided ATV tour on the iconic Rubicon Springs Trail. Experience breathtaking views and unique Tahoe wilderness as you navigate this rugged terrain, stopping at stunning lookout points perfect for photos. 

- 2-hour guided ATV tour along the scenic Rubicon Springs Trail
- Expert guide providing insights and leading to stunning lookout points
